items.title: How Will Air Products and Chemicals Stock React To Its Upcoming Earnings?
items.summary: Air Products and Chemicals (NYSE: APD) will discuss its fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter results on a conference call on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The company has a market value of about $70.4 billion. Over the last twelve months, it generated $12.6 billion in revenue and $3.1 billion in operating profit before charges for business and asset actions. After those charges, it posted a net loss of $47 million.

items.title: What Is Bank of America (BAC) Signaling With Its New Board And Las Vegas Chief?
items.summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) appointed Wendy Franco as president of the Las Vegas market, overseeing local business and community efforts. Jim Fitterling, chair and CEO of Dow Inc., and Bill Thomas, former KPMG International CEO, joined Bank of America’s Board of Directors. Fitterling and Thomas bring experience in technology, AI, global operations and corporate governance from large industrial and professional services organizations.
